```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(nanoparquet)
library(here)
library(tidybayes)
library(nanoparquet)
library(patchwork)
library(bayesplot)
library(modelr)
```

```{r}
model_string <- "foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_7_full.rds"

model <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo_7,
  data = data_sample_full_agg,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = prior_custom_vs_mo,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  file = (here::here("06_model-validation", model_string))
)

data <- read_parquet(here("02_data", "02-3_data_modeling", "sample_359266_factor.parquet"))

data <- data |> 
  mutate(defender_foul_count = factor(defender_foul_count, 
                                   levels = 0:5,
                                   ordered = TRUE))

data <- data |> 
  group_by(offensive_team, defensive_team, primary_defender, shot_movement, shot_type_basic, shot_zone, defender_position, defender_foul_count) |> 
  summarize(shots_defended_made = sum(shots_defended_made),
         shots_defended_total = sum(shots_defended_total))
```

```{r}
mcmc_plot(model)
```

```{r}
plot(model)
```

```{r}
marginal_effects(model)
```

```{r}
neff_plot <- neff_ratio(model) |> mcmc_neff() + labs(title = "Neff Values for Binomial Model",
                                                     subtitle = "Above 0.1 is good"
                                                     )

ggsave(here::here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "neff_plot.png"), neff_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
# Get median values for each shot zone and term combination
mo_zone_foul_order_data <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_shot_zone[shot_zone,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  group_by(shot_zone, term) |>
  summarise(median_value = median(.value), .groups = "drop")

# Plot using the original data but order zones based on medians
mo_zone_foul_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_shot_zone[shot_zone,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  mutate(shot_zone = factor(shot_zone, 
                           levels = mo_zone_foul_order_data |> 
                             filter(term == term[1]) |> 
                             arrange(median_value) |> 
                             pull(shot_zone))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = shot_zone, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(title = "Effect of fouls on\nshotmaking percentage by zone",
       y = "Shot Zone")
  
# Get median values for each shot zone and term combination

  gather_draws(r_shot_zone[shot_zone,term]) |>
```

```{r}
# Get median values for each shot movement and term combination
shot_movement_foul_effect <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_shot_movement[shot_movement,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  group_by(shot_movement, term) |>
  summarise(median_value = median(.value), .groups = "drop")

# Plot using the original data but order shot movements based on medians
shot_movement_foul_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_shot_movement[shot_movement,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  mutate(shot_movement = factor(shot_movement, 
                               levels = shot_movement_foul_effect |> 
                                 arrange(median_value) |> 
                                 pull(shot_movement))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = shot_movement, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(title = "Effect of fouls on shot making by shot movement type",
       subtitle = "Higher values indicate shots are more likely to go in as defender fouls increase",
       x = "Effect size",
       y = "Shot Movement Type")

# Create a grid to simulate predictions for different shot movements and foul counts
shot_movement_pred_data <- data |> 
  ungroup() |>
  data_grid(
    shot_movement,
    defender_foul_count,
    defensive_team = "LAL", # Using Lakers as example
    offensive_team = "BOS", # Using Celtics as example
    primary_defender = "LeBron James", # Example defender
    defender_position = "F", # Forward
    shot_zone = "Paint - Non-RA", # Example zone
    shot_type_basic = "2PT" # Example shot type
  ) |>
  mutate(shots_defended_total = 100) |> 
  add_predicted_draws(model)

# Create plot showing shot making probability by foul count for each shot movement
shot_movement_prediction_plot <- shot_movement_pred_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = defender_foul_count, y = .prediction, color = shot_movement)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = .prediction), .width = c(0.80), alpha = 0.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Predicted shot making probability by defender foul count",
       subtitle = "Different lines represent different shot movement types",
       x = "Defender Foul Count",
       y = "Predicted Shot Making Probability",
       color = "Shot Movement") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display plots
shot_movement_foul_plot

shot_movement_prediction_plot

# Save plots
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "shot_movement_foul_effect.png"), shot_movement_foul_plot, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "shot_movement_prediction_by_fouls.png"), shot_movement_prediction_plot, width = 12, height = 8)

# Create faceted version showing each shot movement separately
shot_movement_facet_plot <- shot_movement_pred_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = defender_foul_count, y = .prediction)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = .prediction), .width = c(0.80), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~shot_movement) +
  labs(title = "Effect of defender foul count on shot making by movement type",
       subtitle = "Shows probability distribution with 80% intervals",
       x = "Defender Foul Count", 
       y = "Predicted Shot Making Probability") +
  theme_minimal()

shot_movement_facet_plot

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "shot_movement_facet_by_fouls.png"), shot_movement_facet_plot, width = 12, height = 8)
```

```{r}
# Get foul effect for all players
player_foul_effects <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |>
  # Convert model player names to match data format (firstname.lastname -> firstname lastname)
  mutate(primary_defender_data = str_replace(primary_defender, "\\.", " "))

# Join with data to get team and position information
player_team_position <- data |> 
  ungroup() |>
  select(primary_defender, defensive_team, defender_position) |>
  distinct()

# Calculate median effect for each player
player_foul_effects_summary <- player_foul_effects |>
  group_by(primary_defender, primary_defender_data) |>
  summarise(median_effect = median(.value), 
            q25 = quantile(.value, 0.25),
            q75 = quantile(.value, 0.75),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  # Join using the converted player name format
  left_join(player_team_position, by = c("primary_defender_data" = "primary_defender"))

# Order teams by median foul effect
team_order <- player_foul_effects_summary |>
  filter(!is.na(defensive_team)) |>
  group_by(defensive_team) |>
  summarise(team_median = median(median_effect, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(team_median) |>
  pull(defensive_team)

# Create a combined filtered and cleaned dataset 
player_team_data_clean <- player_foul_effects_summary |>
  # Remove duplicates (players who played for multiple teams)
  distinct(primary_defender, primary_defender_data, median_effect, q25, q75, defensive_team, defender_position) |>
  # Remove NAs
  filter(!is.na(defensive_team), !is.na(defender_position)) |>
  # Order teams
  mutate(defensive_team = factor(defensive_team, levels = team_order))

# Create PDF with one team per page
pdf(here("07_model-analysis", "team_foul_effects_individual.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)

# Loop through each team to create individual plots
for(team in team_order) {
  # Filter data for current team
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

# Create a comparison of player performance with high vs low fouls
# First, let's select some interesting teams to focus on
focus_teams <- c("LAL", "GSW", "BOS", "MIL", "MIA")

# Create prediction data for players from these teams
player_foul_comparison_data <- data |> 
  ungroup() |>
  filter(defensive_team %in% focus_teams) |>
  # Get unique players from these teams
  select(primary_defender, defensive_team, defender_position) |>
  distinct() |>
  # Create data grid with low and high foul counts for comparison
  crossing(
    defender_foul_count = c("0", "5"),  # Compare 0 fouls vs 5 fouls
    shot_movement = "stationary",  # Use specific shot type for consistency
    offensive_team = "OKC",       # Example offensive team
    shot_zone = "Mid-Range", # Example shot zone
  ) |>
  mutate(shots_defended_total = 100) |> 
  add_predicted_draws(model, ndraws = 200)  # Use fewer draws for efficiency

# Calculate summary stats for each player at each foul level
player_foul_comparison_summary <- player_foul_comparison_data |>
  group_by(primary_defender, defensive_team, defender_position, defender_foul_count) |>
  summarize(
    mean_prediction = mean(.prediction),
    lower_bound = quantile(.prediction, 0.025),
    upper_bound = quantile(.prediction, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Format for plotting
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = defender_foul_count,
    values_from = c(mean_prediction, lower_bound, upper_bound),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  # Calculate the effect size (difference between high and low fouls)
  mutate(
    effect_size = mean_prediction_5 - mean_prediction_0,
    # Create a label for significant effects
    sig_effect = if_else(
      lower_bound_5 > upper_bound_0 | upper_bound_5 < lower_bound_0,
      "Significant",
      "Not Significant"
    )
  ) |>
  # Order by effect size
  arrange(desc(effect_size))

# Create a visualization showing the difference
ggplot(player_foul_comparison_summary, 
       aes(x = mean_prediction_0, 
           y = mean_prediction_5, 
           color = defensive_team,
           shape = defender_position)) +
  # Add diagonal line for reference (no change)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Add points
  geom_point(aes(size = abs(effect_size), alpha = sig_effect == "Significant")) +
  # Add text labels for notable players (those with large effects)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = player_foul_comparison_summary |> 
      filter(abs(effect_size) > quantile(abs(effect_size), 0.9) | 
             (sig_effect == "Significant" & abs(effect_size) > quantile(abs(effect_size), 0.75))),
    aes(label = primary_defender),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 15,
    box.padding = 0.5
  ) +
  # Formatting
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.5)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Player Performance: 0 Fouls vs 5 Fouls",
    subtitle = "Higher values = worse defensive performance (opponent shot makes % increases)",
    x = "Predicted shot make % with 0 fouls",
    y = "Predicted shot make % with 5 fouls",
    color = "Team",
    shape = "Position",
    size = "Effect size",
    alpha = "Statistical significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "player_foul_comparison_scatterplot.png"), width = 12, height = 10)

# Create alternate visualization showing players most and least affected by fouls
# First, filter to most significant players for clarity
top_affected_players <- player_foul_comparison_summary |>
  mutate(abs_effect = abs(effect_size)) |>
  group_by(defensive_team) |>
  # Get top 5 most affected players per team
  slice_max(order_by = abs_effect, n = 5) |>
  ungroup()

# Create a connected dot plot showing low vs high foul performance
ggplot(top_affected_players, aes(y = reorder(primary_defender, effect_size))) +
  # Add low foul point
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_prediction_0, color = "0 Fouls"), size = 3) +
  # Add high foul point
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_prediction_5, color = "5 Fouls"), size = 3) +
  # Connect the points
  geom_segment(aes(x = mean_prediction_0, xend = mean_prediction_5,
                   yend = primary_defender),
               alpha = 0.7) +
  # Facet by team
  facet_wrap(~defensive_team, scales = "free_y") +
  # Formatting
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0 Fouls" = "blue", "5 Fouls" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Player Performance Changes with Increased Foul Count",
    subtitle = "Shows opponent shot make % with 0 vs 5 fouls for most affected players by team",
    x = "Predicted opponent shot make %",
    y = "",
    color = "Foul Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightgrey"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "player_foul_comparison_by_team.png"), width = 12, height = 10)
```

```{r}
# Display and save the plot
zone_line_plot
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", paste0(selected_team, "_zone_foul_trend.png")), 
       zone_line_plot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# 3. Create a heatmap to compare movement vs zone for the top player at high foul count
top_player <- top_players[1]  # Select the most affected player

# Get more detailed data for confidence calculations
heat_data_detailed <- enhanced_prediction_data |>
  filter(primary_defender == top_player,
         defender_foul_count %in% c("0", "5")) |>  # Compare 0 vs 5 fouls
  # Get individual draws for confidence calculation
  select(primary_defender, shot_movement, shot_zone, defender_foul_count, .prediction, .draw) |>
  # Reshape to calculate effect size for each draw
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(primary_defender, shot_movement, shot_zone, .draw),
    names_from = defender_foul_count,
    values_from = .prediction,
    names_prefix = "fouls_"
  ) |>
  # Calculate effect size for each draw
  mutate(effect_size = fouls_5 - fouls_0)

# Summarize to get confidence metrics
heat_data <- heat_data_detailed |>
  group_by(primary_defender, shot_movement, shot_zone) |>
  summarize(
    # Mean effect size
    mean_effect = mean(effect_size),
    # Standard error of the effect size
    se_effect = sd(effect_size) / sqrt(n()),
    # Calculate confidence metrics
    prob_positive = mean(effect_size > 0),  # Probability of positive effect
    prob_negative = mean(effect_size < 0),  # Probability of negative effect
    # Calculate confidence as distance from 0.5 (uncertain) multiplied by 2 to get 0-1 range
    confidence = 2 * abs(prob_positive - 0.5),
    # Calculate confidence intervals
    lower_ci = quantile(effect_size, 0.025),
    upper_ci = quantile(effect_size, 0.975),
    # Determine if effect is "significant" (doesn't cross zero)
    is_significant = (lower_ci > 0) | (upper_ci < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create a heatmap of the effect sizes with confidence-based text transparency
heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heat_data, aes(x = shot_zone, y = shot_movement, fill = mean_effect)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Use a diverging color scale centered at 0
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", 
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Effect Size"
  ) +
  # Add values to tiles with transparency based on confidence
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_effect),
      # Alpha based on confidence (more confident = more opaque)
      alpha = confidence,
      # Make significant effects bold
      fontface = ifelse(is_significant, "bold", "plain")
    ), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 3
  ) +
  # Set scale for transparency
  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.2, 1),
    name = "Confidence"
  ) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = paste0("Effect of Fouls (0 vs 5) for ", top_player, " by Shot Type and Zone"),
    subtitle = "Red = worse defense with fouls, Blue = better defense with fouls\nText opacity shows confidence in effect (darker = more confident)",
    x = "Shot Zone",
    y = "Shot Movement"
  ) +
  # Formatting
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Create a version with confidence intervals shown
heatmap_plot_with_ci <- ggplot(heat_data, aes(x = shot_zone, y = shot_movement, fill = mean_effect)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Use a diverging color scale centered at 0
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", 
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Effect Size"
  ) +
  # Add effect sizes with confidence intervals
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.2f\n[%.2f, %.2f]", mean_effect, lower_ci, upper_ci),
      # Alpha based on confidence
      alpha = confidence,
      # Bold for significant effects
      fontface = ifelse(is_significant, "bold", "plain")
    ), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  # Set scale for transparency
  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.2, 1),
    name = "Confidence"
  ) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = paste0("Effect of Fouls (0 vs 5) for ", top_player, " by Shot Type and Zone"),
    subtitle = "With 95% confidence intervals in brackets\nText opacity shows confidence in effect (darker = more confident)",
    x = "Shot Zone",
    y = "Shot Movement"
  ) +
  # Formatting
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display and save the heatmaps
heatmap_plot
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", paste0(selected_team, "_", gsub(" ", "_", top_player), "_heatmap.png")), 
       heatmap_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

heatmap_plot_with_ci
ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", paste0(selected_team, "_", gsub(" ", "_", top_player), "_heatmap_with_ci.png")), 
       heatmap_plot_with_ci, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Create a function to generate comparative heatmap between two players at two foul counts
compare_players_heatmap <- function(
  player1, 
  player2, 
  foul_count1 = "0", 
  foul_count2 = "5", 
  shot_movement_subset = NULL, 
  shot_zone_subset = NULL,
  offensive_team = "OKC",  # Add offensive_team parameter
  defensive_team = NULL,   # Add defensive_team parameter
  ndraws = 300,
  title = NULL,
  show_uncertainty = TRUE  # Add parameter to toggle uncertainty display
) {
  # Validate inputs
  if (!player1 %in% unique(data$primary_defender)) {
    stop(paste("Player 1:", player1, "not found in data"))
  }
  if (!player2 %in% unique(data$primary_defender)) {
    stop(paste("Player 2:", player2, "not found in data"))
  }
  if (!offensive_team %in% unique(data$offensive_team)) {
    stop(paste("Offensive team:", offensive_team, "not found in data"))
  }
  if (!is.null(defensive_team) && !defensive_team %in% unique(data$defensive_team)) {
    stop(paste("Defensive team:", defensive_team, "not found in data"))
  }
  
  # Filter shot movements and zones if specified
  if (is.null(shot_movement_subset)) {
    shot_movements_to_use <- unique(data$shot_movement)
  } else {
    shot_movements_to_use <- shot_movement_subset
  }
  
  if (is.null(shot_zone_subset)) {
    shot_zones_to_use <- unique(data$shot_zone)
  } else {
    shot_zones_to_use <- shot_zone_subset
  }
  
  # Get team info for the players
  player_info <- data |> 
    ungroup() |>
    filter(primary_defender %in% c(player1, player2))
  
  # Apply defensive team filter if specified
  if (!is.null(defensive_team)) {
    player_info <- player_info |>
      filter(defensive_team == !!defensive_team)
    
    # If no rows left, the players don't play for this team
    if (nrow(player_info) == 0) {
      stop(paste("Neither player plays for the defensive team:", defensive_team))
    }
    
    # Check if both players play for this team
    if (!player1 %in% player_info$primary_defender) {
      stop(paste(player1, "does not play for", defensive_team))
    }
    if (!player2 %in% player_info$primary_defender) {
      stop(paste(player2, "does not play for", defensive_team))
    }
  }
  
  # Get just the player info columns we need
  player_info <- player_info |>
    select(primary_defender, defensive_team, defender_position) |>
    distinct()
  
  # Get positions for both players
  player1_position <- player_info |> 
    filter(primary_defender == player1) |> 
    pull(defender_position) |> 
    unique()
  
  player2_position <- player_info |> 
    filter(primary_defender == player2) |> 
    pull(defender_position) |> 
    unique()
  
  # Get team for each player
  player1_team <- player_info |> 
    filter(primary_defender == player1) |> 
    pull(defensive_team) |> 
    unique()
  
  player2_team <- player_info |> 
    filter(primary_defender == player2) |> 
    pull(defensive_team) |> 
    unique()
  
  # Set default title if not provided, now with player positions
  if (is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste0(
      player1, " (", player1_position, ", ", player1_team, ", ", foul_count1, " fouls) vs ", 
      player2, " (", player2_position, ", ", player2_team, ", ", foul_count2, " fouls)"
    )
  }
  
  # Create player labels with positions for use in subtitle
  player1_label <- paste0(player1, " (", player1_position, ")")
  player2_label <- paste0(player2, " (", player2_position, ")")
  
  # Add the defensive team to the title if specified and not already in the title
  if (!is.null(defensive_team) && is.null(title)) {
    title <- paste0(
      title, " [", defensive_team, " vs ", offensive_team, "]"
    )
  }
  
  # Create prediction data for the two players
  comparison_data <- player_info |>
    # Create data grid with specified combinations
    crossing(
      defender_foul_count = c(foul_count1, foul_count2),
      shot_movement = shot_movements_to_use,
      shot_zone = shot_zones_to_use,
      offensive_team = offensive_team  # Use the specified offensive team
    ) |>
    mutate(shots_defended_total = 100) |> 
    add_predicted_draws(model, ndraws = ndraws)
  
  # Define player-foul combinations for identification
  player1_combo <- paste0(player1, " (", player1_position, ", ", foul_count1, " fouls)")
  player2_combo <- paste0(player2, " (", player2_position, ", ", foul_count2, " fouls)")
  
  # Create a composite identifier for each player-foul combination
  comparison_data <- comparison_data |>
    mutate(player_foul_combo = case_when(
      primary_defender == player1 & defender_foul_count == foul_count1 ~ player1_combo,
      primary_defender == player2 & defender_foul_count == foul_count2 ~ player2_combo,
      TRUE ~ "other"  # Should never happen given the filtering below
    ))
  
  # Filter to only the combinations we care about and keep draw information
  comparison_filtered <- comparison_data |>
    filter(
      (primary_defender == player1 & defender_foul_count == foul_count1) |
      (primary_defender == player2 & defender_foul_count == foul_count2)
    )
  
  # Calculate summary statistics for display
  comparison_summary <- comparison_filtered |>
    group_by(player_foul_combo, shot_movement, shot_zone) |>
    summarize(
      mean_prediction = mean(.prediction),
      lower_bound = quantile(.prediction, 0.025),
      upper_bound = quantile(.prediction, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # For uncertainty calculations, we need to process at the draw level
  difference_by_draw <- comparison_filtered |>
    # Select only the columns we need
    select(player_foul_combo, shot_movement, shot_zone, .draw, .prediction) |>
    # Reshape to wide format to calculate differences within each draw
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(shot_movement, shot_zone, .draw),
      names_from = player_foul_combo,
      values_from = .prediction
    ) |>
    # Calculate the difference for each draw
    mutate(diff = .data[[player1_combo]] - .data[[player2_combo]])
  
  # Now summarize the differences
  difference_summary <- difference_by_draw |>
    group_by(shot_movement, shot_zone) |>
    summarize(
      mean_diff = mean(diff),
      diff_lower_ci = quantile(diff, 0.025),
      diff_upper_ci = quantile(diff, 0.975),
      # Calculate probability of player1 being better (negative diff = better defense)
      prob_player1_better = mean(diff < 0),
      # Confidence in the direction of the effect (how far from 50-50)
      confidence = 2 * abs(prob_player1_better - 0.5),
      # Is the effect "significant" (CI doesn't cross zero)
      is_significant = (diff_lower_ci < 0 & diff_upper_ci < 0) | (diff_lower_ci > 0 & diff_upper_ci > 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Create the heatmap
  matchup_info <- if(!is.null(defensive_team)) {
    paste0(defensive_team, " defense vs ", offensive_team, " offense")
  } else {
    paste0("Against ", offensive_team, " offense")
  }
  
  # Determine what text to show based on uncertainty preference
  if (show_uncertainty) {
    # With confidence intervals
    text_labels <- sprintf("%.2f\n[%.2f, %.2f]", 
                          difference_summary$mean_diff, 
                          difference_summary$diff_lower_ci,
                          difference_summary$diff_upper_ci)
    subtitle_text <- paste0(
      "Green = ", player1_label, " (", foul_count1, " fouls) allows fewer makes\n",
      "Purple = ", player2_label, " (", foul_count2, " fouls) allows fewer makes\n",
      "Values show mean difference with 95% confidence intervals\n",
      matchup_info
    )
  } else {
    # Just the mean difference
    text_labels <- sprintf("%.3f", difference_summary$mean_diff)
    subtitle_text <- paste0(
      "Green = ", player1_label, " (", foul_count1, " fouls) allows fewer makes\n",
      "Purple = ", player2_label, " (", foul_count2, " fouls) allows fewer makes\n",
      matchup_info
    )
  }
  
  # Create the heatmap
  comp_heatmap <- ggplot(difference_summary, aes(x = shot_zone, y = shot_movement, fill = mean_diff)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    # Use a diverging color scale centered at 0
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "green",    # Player 1 better (negative diff)
      mid = "white",
      high = "purple",  # Player 2 better (positive diff)
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "Difference"
    ) +
    # Add values to tiles with transparency based on confidence
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = text_labels,
        alpha = confidence,  # More confident = more opaque
        color = ifelse(abs(mean_diff) > 0.02, ifelse(mean_diff < 0, "white", "white"), "black"),
        fontface = ifelse(is_significant, "bold", "plain")  # Bold for significant effects
      ),
      size = if(show_uncertainty) 2.5 else 3
    ) +
    # Set scales for text appearance
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_alpha_continuous(
      range = c(0.4, 1),
      name = "Confidence"
    ) +
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Shot Zone",
      y = "Shot Movement"
    ) +
    # Formatting
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(comp_heatmap)
}
```

```{r}
model |>
  gather_draws(bsp_modefender_foul_count) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .value)) +
  stat_halfeye(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Global Effect of Increasing Foul Counts on Shot Success",
       subtitle = "Slightly negative effect with uncertainty spanning zero",
       x = "Effect Size (log-odds)",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "global_foul_effect.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Visualize the monotonic simplex parameters
model |>
  gather_draws(simo_modefender_foul_count1[i]) |>
  mutate(foul_transition = paste0(i-1, " to ", i)) |>
  mutate(foul_transition = factor(foul_transition, 
                               levels = c("0 to 1", "1 to 2", "2 to 3", "3 to 4", "4 to 5"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = foul_transition, x = .value)) +
  stat_halfeye(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Monotonic Steps Between Foul Count Levels",
       subtitle = "Largest effects occur at high foul counts (3-4 and 4-5)",
       x = "Step Size",
       y = "Foul Transition") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "monotonic_foul_steps.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Visualize group-level variation
# Extract SD parameters for all group-level effects
group_sds <- model |>
  gather_draws(sd_shot_zone__Intercept, 
               sd_shot_movement__Intercept,
               sd_defensive_team__Intercept,
               sd_offensive_team__Intercept,
               sd_defender_position__Intercept,
               sd_primary_defender__Intercept,
               sd_shot_zone__modefender_foul_count, 
               sd_shot_movement__modefender_foul_count,
               sd_defensive_team__modefender_foul_count,
               sd_defender_position__modefender_foul_count,
               sd_primary_defender__modefender_foul_count) |>
  # Extract grouping variable from parameter name
  mutate(
    param_type = ifelse(str_detect(.variable, "Intercept"), "Baseline", "Foul Effect"),
    group = str_remove(.variable, "sd_"),
    group = str_remove(group, "__Intercept"),
    group = str_remove(group, "__modefender_foul_count")
  )

# Plot group-level SDs
group_sds |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(group, .value, median), x = .value, fill = param_type, color = param_type)) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Variation in Group-Level Effects",
       subtitle = "Shot zone exhibits the largest variability in baseline success rates",
       x = "Standard Deviation",
       y = "Grouping Variable",
       color = "Parameter Type") +
  xlim(0, 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "group_level_variation.png"), width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Visualize correlations between intercepts and slopes
correlation_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(cor_shot_movement__Intercept__modefender_foul_count,
               cor_shot_zone__Intercept__modefender_foul_count,
               cor_defensive_team__Intercept__modefender_foul_count,
               cor_defender_position__Intercept__modefender_foul_count,
               cor_primary_defender__Intercept__modefender_foul_count) |>
  mutate(
    group = str_remove(.variable, "cor_"),
    group = str_remove(group, "__Intercept__modefender_foul_count")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(group, .value, median), x = .value)) +
  stat_halfeye(fill = "orchid", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Correlation Between Baseline Effects and Foul Effects",
       subtitle = "Shot movement shows positive correlation, defensive teams show slight negative correlation",
       x = "Correlation",
       y = "Grouping Variable") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "intercept_slope_correlations.png"), width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
